evidence_extracts.locator: Understanding beyond equations; Narratives of science; Problem-solving versus problem-finding
evidence_extracts.evidence: Perspective distinguishes prediction and problem-solving from contextual scientific explanation and choosing worthwhile problems.
evidence_extracts.observation: Conceptual argument, not a controlled limit on future models.

evidence_extracts.locator: Course homepage, chapter outline and notebook overview
evidence_extracts.evidence: Hands-on astronomy course covers execution, retrieval, agent loops, memory, safety, MCP and skills.
evidence_extracts.observation: Homepage inspected; notebook internals not independently executed or fully inspected. Teaching resource, not an efficacy study.

evidence_extracts.locator: Sections I–III; CIGALE tool interface and diagnostic feedback
evidence_extracts.evidence: Agent selects physical components for galaxy SED modeling using a scientific code, structured numerical diagnostics and accumulated experience.
evidence_extracts.observation: Main experiment uses GPT-4o; task-specific physical-model selection, not general scientific autonomy.

evidence_extracts.locator: Benchmark design; Sections 5.1–5.3; limitations; Appendix C masking
evidence_extracts.evidence: Expert-designed astrophysics replication tasks assess faithfulness and correctness; observed failures differ from merely finishing a task.
evidence_extracts.observation: Dated 2025 model/harness snapshots. Abstract says best under 20%, body/table report 22%; no percentage carried into manuscript.

evidence_extracts.evidence: Extends W3C PROV to connect prompts, responses and agent decisions with downstream workflow data and computation.
evidence_extracts.observation: Infrastructure demonstration and query support do not establish physical correctness.

evidence_extracts.locator: Introduction; workflow Section 2.3; discussion of completed runs
evidence_extracts.evidence: Coding-agent skill links selected targets, evidence, comparisons, report coverage and a workspace completion gate.
evidence_extracts.observation: Completion concerns the recorded target set; runs differ in target decomposition, numerical fidelity and acceptance criteria.

evidence_extracts.evidence: Scores document reconstructability through an information graph from the manuscript.
evidence_extracts.observation: Does not execute code or use replication artifacts. Human comparison has additional context; not equivalent to a rerun.

evidence_extracts.evidence: Proposes verifiable agent-native publishing architecture and formal specification with partial prototype.
evidence_extracts.observation: Explicitly no empirical results; proposal rather than demonstrated effectiveness.

gaps: No independent execution of these systems in this research.
Ting slide deck and Rutgers talk were discovery/context sources, not primary support for model performance.
Not an exhaustive survey of autonomous science.

contradictions.resolution: Do not quote a score; describe evaluation design and dated scope.
